w5ident_rules.rule: A selection is the set of per-reference rows that agree on every property that decides the part: kind, value, land, the required rating, dielectric or construction, tolerance, power, temperature coefficient, the use a value states and any named part. Rows whose requirement differs are separate selections even when one part meets both. ONE EXCEPTION, stated: an inductor whose value names a maker's part is keyed by that part number and its land, and the use the value states is left out of its key, so the XAL1010-682ME and the XAL6030-332ME selections hold rows that state a saturation current beside rows that state none; the named part is the requirement there, and its document gives the current
w5ident_rules.why: the third checkpoint review, section 5: never merge rows whose ratings or functional constraints differ

w5ident_rules.rule: A row that is two parts, a holder that is placed and what is fitted in it at build (a blade fuse in its holder, a coin cell in its holder), has TWO identities: `identity` is the placed part and `fitted` the part fitted in it, each with its own maker, part number, rating and document. The selection is as resolved as the less resolved of the two

w5ident_rules.reversal: declare the net (intent rails or nodes) and the bound or the open item is replaced by the declaration
w5ident_rules.rule: A capacitor's voltage requirement is the stated rating, or the voltage across it from the intent declarations at the project's 20 percent derate margin (derate.py), rounded up to a standard rating. A net nobody declared is BOUNDED by the highest of every source that can set its level, and only when every source is bounded: the declared voltages on an active part's other pins, a declared net reached through a resistor, ferrite, fuse, diode, switch or link, a pin level a maker's document gives (rule V-2). GROUND IS A FLOOR AND NEVER A CEILING: a ground net, or a net declared at or below 0 V, enters no maximum, and a node only ground reaches is UNBOUNDED. A SWITCH NODE IS DECLARED OR UNBOUNDED: an inductor that is not a ferrite, with either node on a Q, D or U, passes nothing; the project declares its switch nodes in the intent (v_max the larger rail the node reaches, v_min -1.0 V) and declares no ringing figure, so an undeclared one is not bounded here. A net the intent declares with no maximum is UNBOUNDED. A stated rating is never lowered and is raised only by a DECLARED voltage. An UNBOUNDED side leaves an unstated requirement OPEN (the selection is UNRESOLVED: no part is guessed) and a stated one NOT CHECKED
w5ident_rules.why: the value strings state a rating on under a third of the capacitors; CMP-001 needs the voltage across the part. Corrected after the first check of pass 1 found ground bounding other nets at 0.0 V (83 row-nets) and a boost's switch node reading its input rail

w5ident_rules.rule: The role of a pin is read from its maker's document filed in the tree where the netlist and the intent cannot say it (PIN_ROLES in part_identities.py): an input is not a source; an output's ceiling is the level the document gives; a pin the device holds from its supply pins tracks them; a pin driven at a level the document does not state is a source of unknown level.
